# VRT MAX Communicatie

> Official communication hub for VRT MAX, Belgium's premier streaming platform featuring original series, documentaries, and podcasts.

VRT MAX Communicatie serves as the news and announcement center for VRT MAX, showcasing Belgian entertainment content including drama series, reality shows, documentaries, and podcast launches. The site highlights new releases, season announcements, and exclusive content from creators and hosts across Flanders.

## Featured Series & Releases

- [De speeltijd is voorbij: laatste seizoen Knokke off vanaf 3 april op VRT MAX](https://communicatie.vrtmax.be/de-speeltijd-is-voorbij-laatste-seizoen-knokke-off-vanaf-3-april-op-vrt-max): Final season announcement for Belgian drama series Knokke off premiering April 2025.
- [Nog 1 maand tot 30 Jaar Thuis! Best episodes streaming on VRT MAX](https://communicatie.vrtmax.be/nog-1-maand-tot-30-jaar-thuis-dat-is-1-maand-lang-de-allerbeste-grappigste-aangrijpendste-scenes-afleveringen-en-gebeurtenissen): 30-year Thuis anniversary celebration with 300 best episodes on VRT MAX.
- [Is er leven na de kater? 9 feestjes voor de kater 2 nu volledig te bingen](https://communicatie.vrtmax.be/is-er-leven-na-de-kater-9-feestjes-voor-de-kater-2-nu-volledig-te-bingen-op-vrt-max): Season 2 release announcement for Belgian comedy-romance web series 9 feestjes.
- [Roomies 2 in première op Film Fest Gent](https://communicatie.vrtmax.be/roomies-2-in-premiere-op-film-fest-gent): Roomies 2 premieres at Film Fest Gent with acclaimed cast and soundtrack.

## Podcasts & Audio Content

- [Gooi je algoritme op tafel want Gij Weet is terug!](https://communicatie.vrtmax.be/gooi-je-algoritme-op-tafel-want-gij-weet-is-terug): Season 2 announcement for Gij Weet with hosts Hakim Chatar and Soukaïna Bennani.
- [Iedereen boos: Sander en Cato preview Thuis midseason finale](https://communicatie.vrtmax.be/iedereen-boos-sander-en-cato-blikken-vooruit-naar-de-midseasonfinale-van-thuis-en-geven-duotickets-voor-de-warmste-watchparty-weg): Welkom Thuis podcast episode with Sander and Cato discussing Thuis and ticket giveaway.
- [Hakim wil gewoon seks hebben: Jolien Roets and Hakim Chatar host Welkom Thuis](https://communicatie.vrtmax.be/hakim-wil-gewoon-seks-hebben-in-een-vuilkar-jolien-roets-en-hakim-chatar-hosten-deze-week-welkom-thuis-samen-met-cato-peeters): Welkom Thuis podcast episode with Jolien Roets and Hakim Chatar discussing Thuis.
- [Van Instagram Juice tot Julius Caesar: Opnieuw & Opnieuw podcast launch](https://communicatie.vrtmax.be/van-instagram-juice-tot-julius-caesar-vrt-max-lanceert-podcast-opnieuw--opnieuw-met-anna-livia-smekens-en-ayoub-hassani): New podcast Opnieuw & Opnieuw with Anna-Livia Smekens and Ayoub Hassani on history.
- [De schaduwzijde van de geschiedenis in De kunst van het verdwijnen 2](https://communicatie.vrtmax.be/de-schaduwzijde-van-de-geschiedenis-in-de-kunst-van-het-verdwijnen-2): Podcast sequel announcement by Bart Van Nuffelen on WWII and Antwerp Diamond District.

## Documentary Series

- [Oh my god! Sarah Mouhamou explores religion and meaning with Gen Z](https://communicatie.vrtmax.be/oh-my-god-sarah-mouhamou-op-zoek-naar-zingeving-en-religie-bij-gen-z): Six-part documentary series with Sarah Mouhamou on Gen Z spirituality and beliefs.
- [Merci Mercie: Steffi Mercie shares online wellness tips for Gen Z](https://communicatie.vrtmax.be/merci-mercie-content-creator-steffi-mercie-verzamelt-tips-en-tricks-voor-een-gelukkig-online-leven): Documentary series with TikTok creator Steffi Mercie on digital wellness and safety.
- [Leuven Calling: een blik op Leuven door vier nieuwe ogen](https://communicatie.vrtmax.be/leuven-calling-een-blik-op-leuven-door-vier-nieuwe-ogen): Documentary series about international students in Leuven and student life experiences.
